summary: Lightspeed Commerce filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim financial statements and MD&A for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications under Canadian Form 52-109F2. Revenue rose to $323.8 million from $319.0 million year over year, gross profit improved to $142.8 million, and the operating loss narrowed to $7.8 million. Cash fell to $342.9 million from $453.9 million. A $2.1 million gain on sale of business and $3.5 million restructuring charge appear. This is a routine quarterly reporting filing, not a special situation.
